Completely show the full body of the character in T-pose. Standing upright, facing forward. Arms raise horizontally at shoulder height. Palms facing down, remove handheld objects but keep hand-worn equipment and accessories. Legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Keep natural body proportions and anatomy. Front view, neutral background.
A new character: an amateur football player, an Italian American man in his sixties, a running back who is by far the strongest on the team and runs straight through people: short and barrel-chested with a bull neck, huge round shoulders, very thick hairy forearms, a hard round belly and short powerful legs, olive skin, thick curly iron-grey hair, a big hooked nose, grey stubble, a jutting chin and a stubborn closed-mouth frown, wearing bright red sneakers. He wears exactly the same kit as the character in image[1] (plain white short-sleeved jersey, plain mid grey shorts, dark charcoal grey socks) and is made in exactly the same hand-sculpted clay art style, surface texture, level of detail, lighting and background as image[1], but is a completely different person: a different face, skin colour, hair, age and body, with no blond hair, no balding top, no red nose and no beard: thick curly grey hair and stubble. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
